name: ValueCell
description: Community multi-agent platform for financial research, news tracking and automated crypto strategy trading with locally stored data.
whatItDoes: Offers research, news and strategy agents for investors, including live strategy execution on supported crypto exchanges. Secrets and data stay on the user's device.
howItWorks: A local application starts a Python backend and web front end from a single script, with model keys and exchange credentials entered in the interface. Agents call a choice of LLM providers and exchange APIs.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Azure, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

requirements.name: Exchange API credentials
requirements.description: Binance, Hyperliquid, OKX and others for live strategies

models: OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Azure, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible
